question: What types of trees are permitted for making the pole?
premises: Any tree mentioned in the śūla text is permitted.
Bark-pith trees, areca-nut trees, and others are also permitted.
inference: The pole may be made from any tree mentioned in the śūla text, or from bark-pith, areca-nut, and similar trees.
plain_english: Any tree mentioned in the śūla text may be used, or bark-pith trees, areca-nut trees, and so forth.
